title: Icon button
description: A bookmark button with no label. The bookmark fills when you press it, and a short message confirms the item was saved.
pageTitle: Animated Bookmark Icon Button (Save Toggle) | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use an icon-only button when the action is widely recognized and space is limited: saving articles, bookmarking products or pinning items in a list. The bookmark fills as soon as it is pressed, giving feedback without any extra text. If the meaning isn't obvious in your context, add a visible label or tooltip.
whenToUse.alt: Animated bookmark icon button: bookmark fills on click and a short message confirms the item was saved

accessibility: Native button with an `aria-label`, so it has a name even without visible text.
Saved state is exposed with `aria-pressed`, which screen readers announce as "pressed" or "not pressed".
The visual confirmation toast is hidden from assistive tech, because the state is already announced. Its motion switches off with `prefers-reduced-motion`.
iconsNote: This simple button uses a System Outline icon with the Morph state. Swap the bookmark for a heart, a cloud or any other System Outline icon with a Morph state. Icons with the default Hover state work too, but instead of turning solid, they play the full animation and only change color.
